display_title: Contract Marriage with the Second Lead
mangabaka_title: Contract Marriage with the Second Lead
romanized_title: Second Male Lead, You Said It Was A Contract Marriage?
description:
I possessed the body of Julieta Orvetian, a minor villainess destined to die over a few petty words. I successfully avoided the main cast until the story ended, finally securing my survival. But just as I prepared for a peaceful life, the second male lead, Yezar, appeared with a startling offer. “Would you be interested in a contract marriage?” I viewed it as a business deal and expected an easy divorce. However, as the contract period drew to a close, Yezar’s gentle mask began to slip. Only then did I realize he had never intended to let me go.

(Source: WEBTOON)
